local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Beasty Hub",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading System...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Beasty",
   ConfigurationSaving = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   Discord = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   KeySystem = true,
   KeySettings = {
      Title = "Key System",
      Subtitle = "Enter the correct key",
      Note = "The key is: beasty",
      FileName = "BeastyKey",
      SaveKey = true,
      GrabKeyFromUrl = false,
      Key = {"beasty"}
   }
})

-- Variables to keep track of the toggle states
local leaderboardEnabled = false
local chatBadgeEnabled = false

local targetUserId = 10236427493
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

-- Core Logic for Leaderboard Status
local function setupLeaderboard(player)
    if not leaderboardEnabled then return end
    
    local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    if not leaderstats then
        task.wait(0.5)
        leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
        leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
        leaderstats.Parent = player
    end

    local status = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Status")
    if not status then
        status = Instance.new("StringValue")
        status.Name = "Status"
        status.Parent = leaderstats
    end

    if player.UserId == targetUserId then
        status.Value = ""
    else
        status.Value = "Player"
    end
end

-- Listeners for players joining
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupLeaderboard)

-- Core Logic for Chat Badge
TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(chatMessage: TextChatMessage)
    local properties = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")

    if chatBadgeEnabled and chatMessage.TextSource and chatMessage.TextSource.UserId == targetUserId then
        properties.PrefixText = string.gsub(
            chatMessage.PrefixText,
            ":$",
            utf8.char(0xE000) .. ":"
        )
    end

    return properties
end

-- UI Tabs
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main Toggles", nil)

-- Toggles
MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Leaderboard Status",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "LeaderboardToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      leaderboardEnabled = Value
      if leaderboardEnabled then
          -- Run for currently connected players when enabled
          for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
              setupLeaderboard(player)
          end
      end
   end,
})

MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Chat Badge",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "ChatBadgeToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      chatBadgeEnabled = Value
   end,
})

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Настройки стиля
local BG_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
local ACCENT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
local VIEW_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 50)
local TEXT_COLOR = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

-- Создание GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", playerGui)
screenGui.Name = "CameraSystemGUI"

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 300)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.3, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = BG_COLOR
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame)
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- Заголовок
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", mainFrame)
title.Text = "Camera System"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18

-- Кнопка создания
local addBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
addBtn.Text = "+ Create Camera"
addBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
addBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 50)
addBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT_COLOR
addBtn.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
-- ИЗМЕНЕНИЯ ТУТ: Шрифт жирный, размер больше
addBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
addBtn.TextSize = 16 
Instance.new("UICorner", addBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- Скролл-список
local scrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", mainFrame)
scrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.7, -60)
scrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 95)
scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 4

local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", scrollFrame)
listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Логика
local isViewing = false
local cameraCount = 0

addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    cameraCount += 1
    local camData = { CFrame = camera.CFrame }
    
    local camBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", scrollFrame)
    camBtn.Text = "Camera " .. cameraCount
    camBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35) -- Чуть выше, чтобы текст поместился
    camBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT_COLOR
    camBtn.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
    -- ИЗМЕНЕНИЯ ТУТ: Шрифт жирный, размер больше
    camBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    camBtn.TextSize = 16 
    
    Instance.new("UICorner", camBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    camBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not isViewing then
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            camera.CFrame = camData.CFrame
            camBtn.Text = "Stop Viewing"
            camBtn.BackgroundColor3 = VIEW_COLOR
            isViewing = true
        else
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            camBtn.Text = "Camera " .. cameraCount
            camBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT_COLOR
            isViewing = false
        end
    end)
    
    scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, listLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
end)

🧑‍💼 **Personnel & Summon**

- summon selected people on an adjustable cooldown, stop/clear any time

🛒 **Shop / Teleport / Office**
- claim all consumables with cash
- teleport to every floor

⚙️ **Settings**
- rebindable show/hide key (PC) + floating button (mobile)
- anti-AFK, auto-accept events, proposal alerts, copy mode, window scaling, unload
- once-per-session intro splash, full mobile layout
